title: Topic 20 マナー
japanese_text:
A：田中先生へのプレゼントに手紙を添えたいんだ。どんな相談に対しても<u>的確な</u>アドバイスをしてくださる、みんなから敬われていた先生で…。
B：いい先生なんだね。
A：うん。あ、先生への手紙に「田中<u>殿</u>」って書いてもいいのかな。
B：ううん、先生に対して「殿」は使わないよ。
english_translation: A: I want to attach a letter to my present for Mr. Tanaka. He was respected by everyone and always gave such sound advice ... B: He's a great teacher, isn't he? A: Yes. I wonder if I should address him as "Tanaka-dono" in my letter. B: No, dono isn't used for teachers.

annotated_words.meaning_en: ~dono [honorific suffix for names, often used for business or personal correspondence]
